dateAssessment: No absolute campaign date is spoken. The opening is approximately 23:00; using YAML’s May 30, 1749 start conditionally puts the explicitly next-day evening arrival on May 31. YAML’s recorded May 30 end conflicts with that overnight journey (t04). The corrected six-days-earlier Apollyon recap and the morning return are background, not additional played intervals. The eight-hour long-rest convention is contained within the flight, not added to its elapsed span; its precise start and end watches are open. The DM’s “1220” at u2310–u2314 refers to ending the recording, not an in-world clock.

watches.summary: Opening about 11 p.m.; Seeker’s five-minute silence and the brief thought probe follow.
Flight continues through the next day; long rest aboard, arrival around evening before nightfall.
